problem: The text says 'the divisor 100 normalises each penalty so it is dimensionless'. Dividing a quantity in hertz by 100 does not remove its units; the F0 term is still measured in units of 100 Hz and the duration term in units of 100 ms. A student would wrongly believe cost is a pure number with no units and would be confused about why 100 was chosen.
fix: Say: 'the divisor 100 rescales the F0 penalty (hertz) and the duration penalty (milliseconds) into units of 100 Hz and 100 ms, so both terms are of similar size and can be added after weighting; it puts them on a comparable scale, it does not remove the units.'

problem: 'Grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, G2P, is the name for this step' comes after the sentence defining a phoneme, so 'this step' no longer clearly points to the conversion step.
fix: Write: 'Grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, G2P, is the name for the step that turns a written word into its phoneme string.'
